verdict.rationale: Linear's changelog says any filtered view can be shared by copying its URL or with a keyboard shortcut, which covers the share-by-link part directly. Persistent views are implied by references to project views that users can subscribe to, but the docs never describe how a filtered view is saved. missing for 10: explicit documentation of saving/creating a custom filtered view, independent or hands-on corroboration of view sharing.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can save a filtered view of work and share it with a link

citations.quote: You can now share any filtered view by copying its URL from your browser, or by pressing ⌘/Ctrl Shift C on desktop.
Added ability to subscribe to events in project views and receive notifications in Inbox or Slack
